name: Bahrain (1972–2002)
description: A red field with a white vertical stripe at the hoist, the two separated by a serrated line of eight white points.
history: Version of the Bahraini flag in use from 1972, when the serrated edge was simplified from twenty-eight to eight points. On 14 February 2002 King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa's Decree by Law No. 4 reduced the points to five, one for each of the Five Pillars of Islam, producing the present flag.
